title: Chapter 138
text:
"Missile coverage!"

The missile vehicles in Stardragon's base fired a dense array of rockets, hitting the Germinal Organization's fleet head-on. The rapidly approaching missiles let out a shrill whistle, and the pressure increased rapidly as the distance closed.

However, Ugar did not panic at all. He ordered the convoy to gather together. The dozen or so leading vehicles were equipped with multi-barreled machine guns. They acted as an interception formation. Due to the gathering of the formation, the attack area was reduced. The machine guns that spat out a barrage of bullets destroyed the missiles within the range, forming a vacuum area in the range of the missiles. They rushed through the airwaves caused by the explosion, like a warship sailing steadily in the stormy sea.

Huang Qiuming's eyes narrowed.

He had just received news that the battle at Tedramira River had reached its climax. The people in the strategy department had estimated a few possible locations where the Germinal Organization's naval and land forces would land. The strategy department had asked him to activate Plan B. The plan was changed. Huang Qiuming ordered to adjust the deployment, leaving a gap in the blockade.

At this time, Rainy Kim brought the two tired people to the front line under the pretext of transporting supplies. A large number of regular soldiers had already gathered there, ready to go. The armored vehicles' engines roared, and there were also elite soldiers on standby.

"Do you have any idea how we should intervene in the battle?" Sleepy Winter asked helplessly.

Rainy Kim frowned and thought for a few seconds before nodding seriously. "I don't know."

Then why the hell did you nod! Sleepy Winter wanted to bang his head on the ground.

Twinkle Fried Rice suddenly pointed at the battlefield and exclaimed, "Someone is rushing over! F * ck, that's a high-level figure! "

The other two looked in the direction of the finger and saw a muscular man leading a group of fully armed soldiers. They rode on heavy motorcycles and left the convoy. They charged at high speed in the direction of the camp, dodging the concentrated fire of the cannons with all kinds of unpredictable movements.

…

Mihawks dodged a series of attacks on the heavy motorcycles, but it triggered a bouncing mine and flipped over the motorcycles. He ran with his legs, and his speed was not slower than the motorcycles. He weaved through the rain of bullets. The military suitcase under his armpit contained a single bomb, which was extremely powerful. His mission was to deliver this bomb to the Stardragon base.

Supers usually played the role of the shock troops in large-scale frontal battles. Mihawks saw a team of iron-blooded elites rushing from afar to intercept them.

He was expressionless. He gathered all the energy in his body, ready to explode at the moment of contact.

However, an extremely dangerous intuition suddenly rose in Mihawks' heart. He stomped on the ground and hurriedly tried to change direction. His reaction was very fast.

But it was not fast enough!

A blue needle bullet pierced through Mihawx's neck from the side and exploded into a mist of blood. Mihawx was severely injured. He roared and spat out a mouthful of blood. There was no barrier in the plain, so he could only continue to charge forward. However, the injury slowed him down.

A martial artist who had charged head-on into the cannon was seriously injured by a single shot!

Huang Qiuming was shocked.

"That's not one of us. Who's the sniper?"

He recalled the suspicious target detected by the radar earlier and suddenly felt that this shot seemed a little familiar. After thinking for two seconds, his eyes suddenly widened.

A monster-level sniper who could severely injure an expert with one shot seemed to be the Black Phantom who had been active in the underground world recently.

The bullet had a blue glow, so it was most likely him!

What was he doing here? Why are you helping us?

"Commander, what should we do?" the adjutant asked.

Huang Qiuming had a plan and said decisively, "He doesn't look like an enemy. Ignore him and focus on stopping the Germinal Organization."

Normally, a sniper's lethality was limited in a head-on battle like this, but a monster-level sniper like Black Phantom was naturally not an exception.

Although they did not know why Black Phantom had helped them, there was no doubt that this was a strong ally!

…

On the Germinal Organization's side, Ugar's eyes were about to spit fire.

"Severely injuring Mihawx with one shot, Black Phantom! He even intercepted Freier's troops not long ago. This monster actually participated in the battle. He must be Stardragon's ally! "

Thinking of Black Phantom's battle record on the Dark Net, Ugar felt heavy pressure. That was a monster known as the 'Super Killer'. The threat was too great. Even if Ugar was stronger than Mihawx, he was not willing to experience the power of Black Phantom himself.

Ugar mistakenly thought that Han Xiao was Stardragon's ally and was very angry. He immediately made a decision and shouted, "Third team, you guys go and kill the sniper. Bring along the test subjects and at least hold him back!"

An armed convoy deviated from the main group and rushed toward Han Xiao's position.

…

You have inflicted 1,297 actual damage to Mihawx (LV40)!

You have inflicted heavy damage to Mihawx.

Mihawx is now in a weakened state. All attributes decreased by 50%. Duration: 10 seconds.

This guy is quite tanky. Han Xiao was secretly surprised. The theoretical damage of this shot was 1.6, but the damage reduction was 300 points. The physical fitness of a Pugilist could not be measured by common sense. Even the LV48 Bai Jin was knocked down with one shot. Pugilists were indeed tanky.

This time, [Flaming Will]'s face was very dark. It was only a 148% bonus, but the Ghost sniper rifle had been improved even more. Furthermore, all of his shooting skills were maxed out. Two months of experience was not earned for nothing. Since he could not level up, Han Xiao used all of his remaining experience to level up his skills. Talents, skills, and equipment were the key factors that affected combat power!

After firing the first shot, Han Xiao triggered a new mission.

[Battle of Tedramira River (Intruder)]: You have intruded into the battle between Stardragon and Hesla to intercept the Germinal Organization. Since you have chosen a side, let's see what you can do.

This was a C-level mission. The mission requirement was to intercept the Germinal Organization's troops as much as possible and destroy the evacuation plan. The final reward would be given in the form of a mission evaluation.

The experience points should not be less than 300,000. Han Xiao was very satisfied that he could earn a sizable amount of experience points by joining in the fun.

Milhawk was shot after shot. In the end, Milhawk did not manage to dodge the dense bombardment of rockets. The flames engulfed his furious and unwilling face.

A Pugilist who was even stronger than Pan Kuang had fallen.

Pugilists are good at one-on-one combat. To fight an army head-on, even a low-tech civilization would have to have at least half of Bennett's strength, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Pugilists were masters at using physical strength. Everyone had a sense of personal heroism in their hearts. Pugilist combat gave people a special sense of fulfillment. It made people feel that their strength came from themselves and could be used at any time. It was very cool.

However, although Pugilist combat was unique, to fight an army head-on, they had to accumulate from quantity to quality. The C-level was the dividing line, and it was also the upper limit of the players in Version 1.0.

Back to the main topic.

The threat of the sniper made the assault team helpless. They were quickly surrounded by Stardragon's response team. With Han Xiao's intervention, the assault plan failed without even causing a ripple.

At this time, he noticed that a group of tanks had left the Germinal Organization's troops and was rushing over from afar. Thus, he changed his focus and stopped this group of enemies. He switched to the Red Falcon sniper rifle and used all kinds of ammunition. Thinking that Stardragon was also on the battlefield, Han Xiao purposely did not use high-explosive ammunition.

Sniper rifles had limited damage to armored vehicles, and the bulletproof glass could block a few shots. Quickly approaching within 400 meters, Han Xiao immediately activated the foldable turret that he had set up.

Three hundred meters in front of the convoy, four pre-buried round bases opened up and turned into small multi-barreled machine guns. They surrounded the hill where Han Xiao was standing in a triangle and spat out hot steel. The gun flames were bright and dazzling. A few vehicles were directly shot through and exploded by the dense gunfire. The remaining people quickly scattered and aimed at the turret to counterattack.

Once the formation was scattered, the turret's suppressive power decreased by a lot. Because of the need to turn and aim, it was easy to have gaps in firepower.

Turrets were not good at defense. Even if Han Xiao used platinum alloy as armor, two turrets were destroyed in a few seconds. However, the result was very satisfying. More than half of the vehicles were shot through by the turrets, and the momentum of the enemy's charge was reduced.

At this moment, the convoy suddenly did something unexpected. The back door of one of the armored vehicles opened, and three humanoid figures jumped out of the vehicle and ran towards the turret. Their speed was even faster than the armored vehicles, and the strange appearance of the three humanoid figures made Frenzied Sword, who was beside him, suck in a cold breath.

"What kind of monster is that?" Mad Blade wanted to throw a detection spell, but he was told that the distance was not enough.

The three of them were muscular, and their faces were emotionless. A large number of metal exoskeleton components were embedded in their bodies, distributed along the arms, legs, and spine. These components were embedded in the joints of the human body. For example, the mechanical leg ports were embedded in the waist, pelvis, and knees. As the three of them ran, the screws where the joints were embedded would bleed. It was obvious that every movement was painful. However, the three of them did not show any expression, as if they did not feel pain.

Moreover, a thin layer of armor was embedded in their bare skin, as if they had grown a layer of carapace.
